text:
incident-bot: PAGER: elevated 5xx + client timeouts observed on gateway-prod (region-us-west). alert threshold breached at 2028-05-12T09:13:19Z :rotating_light:

maria.sre: I'm on it. pulling initial metrics, paging @lee_oncall and @aj_devex for triage.

lee_oncall: got it, joining. quick ask — is this a global spike or specific routes?

aj_devex: seeing spike on /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints. 502 and 504 increase starting ~09:12:30Z. Latency tail > 10s for some requests.

carmen_support: hit from a customer in EMEA reporting failed requests to the embed endpoint too. severity: customer-impacting.

maria.sre: status page: draft outage entry started. estimate affected users: 10-15% of requests, focused on long sequences.

lee_oncall: mitigation idea — enable fallback routing to smaller model variant and increase gateway timeouts temporarily. anyone opposed?

aj_devex: +1 for fallback. we should also enable short-circuit cache for common prefixes to reduce backend load.

maria.sre: executing runbook step: escalate to dedicated routing team, and temporarily raise upstream retries to 1 -> 0 to avoid amplification. I'll annotate change in the audit log.

ops-bot: change applied: gateway.retry.max_attempts set from 1 to 0 for prod-gateway@us-west at 2028-05-12T09:16:02Z by maria.sre.

lee_oncall: rolling config change to route requests to model-variant v2-small for routes with request_size > 16k tokens. doing canary 10% now.

aj_devex: canary looks clean so far. 5xx rate down for canary traffic.

carmen_support: customer update posted to the affected accounts: "We're investigating elevated errors; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up."

maria.sre: collecting logs. if anyone sees correlation_id strings, paste them here. looking for repeated patterns: upstream connection resets or 502 bodies "upstream unavailable".

aj_devex: found suspect trace: correlation_id=cid-8a7f2b; sample request shows gateway 502 returned after 9.8s with upstream error from model-router: 

```
[2028-05-12T09:14:58Z] cid=cid-8a7f2b method=POST path=/v1/generate status=502 latency=9.86s upstream=10.01s upstream_service=model-router error="503 Service Unavailable"
```

lee_oncall: another sample: cid=cid-8a9d4c with 504 timeout; backend logs show connection reset while reading body.

aj_devex: running correlation query across 09:10-09:20Z window for model-router: increased 502 count ~x12 vs baseline, concurrent connections also spiked.

maria.sre: hypothesis H1: model-router experienced head-of-line/backpressure on long-running sessions causing upstream timeouts -> leads to gateway 502/504. H2: autoretry amplification from a misconfigured client caused burst. H3: a recent kernel patch on a subset of hosts reduced max open file descriptors.

lee_oncall: evidence vs H1: connection queue length metric for model-router nodes shows backlog rising at 09:11Z. worker process CPU not saturated but accept queue full on 3 hosts.

aj_devex: evidence vs H2: logs show we previously lowered retries, ops-bot change listed. client retry loops show retries outside gateway (some SDKs) but not abnormal. H2 lower probability.

carmen_support: H3 check — do we have any rollout around 09:05-09:10?

maria.sre: checked deploy log: no infra kernel updates pushed in that window. there was a model-router config push at 08:57, but it was rolled back at 09:05.

lee_oncall: action item A1: scale model-router pool by +4 instances and drain the 3 hosts with high accept queue. starting now.

ops-bot: scaling action: model-router pool scaled +4 instances at 2028-05-12T09:18:40Z by lee_oncall.

aj_devex: after scale, 5xx rate dropped ~70% in 90s. latency tail improving.

maria.sre: action A2: leave gateway.retry.max_attempts=0 for now. A3: keep canary fallback for 25%. monitor for 30m.

lee_oncall: capturing timeline for RCA:
- 09:11:20Z: first uptick in 502s
- 09:12:30Z: alert threshold breached -> pager fired
- 09:16:02Z: retries disabled at gateway
- 09:18:40Z: model-router scaled +4
- 09:20:10Z: 5xx rate dropped to near baseline for majority routes

aj_devex: logs to attach for postmortem: sample_cids.txt, gateway-metrics-09-10-09-30.json, model-router-acceptq.csv. I'll upload to the incident bucket.

carmen_support: customer comms: updated status page and emailed affected customers at 09:25Z.

maria.sre: post-incident follow-ups (prelim): 1) add queuing backpressure alert for accept queue; 2) investigate model-router config push rolled back at 09:05 — why rollback triggered and whether it contributed; 3) document a standard fallback percentage and automation for long-run requests.

lee_oncall: agree. also we should add correlation_id header passthrough into model-router logs to make triage faster.

aj_devex: adding to ops runbook: when gateway latency tail > 5s, autoscale model-router before retry changes.

maria.sre: leaving handoff to oncall rotation: @lee_oncall will remain the incident lead for the next 2 hours for monitoring and RCA notes.

lee_oncall: taking handoff. I'll run deeper trace sampling and collect heap/stack dumps from the 3 affected hosts if the issue recurs.

incident-bot: incident resolved: 5xx spike mitigated at 2028-05-12T09:20:45Z. Ticket created: INC-2028-314.

carmen_support: thanks team. I'll prepare a customer-facing follow-up and link to the postmortem.

maria.sre: thanks all. we'll open the RCA doc and link logs + the timeline. final note: keep this thread for hypotheses/evidence only — move chatter to #general. :white_check_mark:
